title: English Practice Quiz 0962
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A leaking tap should be ___.
questions.explanation: Prompt repair can prevent water waste and further damage.

questions.question: Which tool is commonly used to tighten a screw?
questions.explanation: A screwdriver is designed to turn screws.

questions.question: Before cleaning an electrical appliance, you should generally ___.
options: switch it off and unplug it
questions.explanation: Disconnecting power reduces the risk of electric shock.

questions.question: A smoke alarm is designed to ___.
options: warn people about smoke or possible fire
open the windows automatically in every model
questions.explanation: Smoke alarms provide an early warning of smoke.

questions.question: If a floor has just been mopped, place a warning sign to ___.
options: alert people to a slipping hazard
show that cleaning is finished forever
questions.explanation: A warning sign helps prevent slips on a wet floor.

questions.question: A clogged drain may cause water to ___.
questions.explanation: A blockage restricts the flow of water.

questions.question: Which item is suitable for wiping dust from furniture?
questions.explanation: A microfiber cloth is commonly used to collect dust.

questions.question: A circuit breaker is used to ___.
options: interrupt an electrical circuit when a fault occurs
measure the length of a room
questions.explanation: A breaker helps protect circuits by cutting off power under specified fault conditions.

questions.question: To prevent mould, a room should have adequate ___.
A maintenance checklist helps staff ___.
questions.explanation: Checklists support consistent inspections and record keeping.
